ella está en pijama y baja en el ascensor

sharpen my nails, my sugar's paying for it"

questions.issue: 'reshuleo vacileo salimos de roneo': 'roneo' unclear (rum/cruising? 'ronear'=hang around); translated as going out on the prowl.

questions.original: mete el bafle enel coche keoi hay parkineo
questions.issue: 'keoi hay parkineo' - unsure of 'keoi' ('que hoy'? 'ke oye'?); translated as 'there's parking today'.

questions.original: Las almendras marcan, cuadradas levantan, ballarina raja y stiletto clava
questions.issue: Nail shapes (almond, square, ballerina/coffin, stiletto) with verbs marcan/levantan/raja/clava; kept literal, 'marcan/levantan' are probably double entendres about fighting.

questions.original: Estoy en mi piso y pasa el afilador
questions.issue: 'afilador' = knife-grinder who passes through streets with a pan-pipe whistle; Basque 'zorrotzailea' may sound odd, but nothing better.
Basque for 'No llevo navajas' - I used 'labana txikirik' (small knife) because 'nabaja' is the Basque loan; check, could use 'nabajarik'.

questions.original: hemos llegado a unas kelis menudo poderío
questions.issue: 'kelis' = houses/cribs (caló 'keli'); 'menudo poderío' translated as 'talk about power'.
'drones camara kiero ese vestido': unsure what 'camara' refers to; translated literally.
